tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and archive identify a plausible sink-coupled dual-horizon adaptation law, but the five paid rows cover only short horizons despite a target horizon of 22.4. Acquire the slow-horizon probe to determine whether the predicted adaptation reversal occurs before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit node_S_sink_dual_horizon_5p from the five initial rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observed horizons are only 0.16–0.48, so the slow adaptation timescale and long-horizon reversal are not identifiable.
The evidence points to node S's dual-horizon law, not a coupled memory ODE; its 5-parameter fit needs a slow-horizon discriminating observation.
It does not resolve the horizon ambiguity and is explicitly irrelevant.
